body:
> Found piloting hkb on `french-tech-homies/pipao-v2` on 2026-08-27/28. Hit on **both** tracks set up that night (#103 and #112).

## Why

`hkb adopt <n> --agent claude-track` adds `kb:agent:claude-track` but leaves the existing `kb:agent:claude` in place. The task then carries two `kb:agent:*` labels, and the resolver takes the first — so the task still resolves to `claude`.

The failure is silent and total for tracks:

```
$ hkb adopt 103 --agent claude-track --status todo
#103 adopted → todo (claude-track)          # says it worked

$ hkb show 103 --json | jq -r '.agent, (.labels|join(" "))'
claude
enhancement kb:status:todo kb:board:default kb:agent:claude kb:agent:claude-track

$ hkb dispatch --dry-run
[dry-run] ... tracks 0/0 ...               # not recognised as a track root
  claimed #106 attempt 1 → claude          # falls back to node dispatch
```

After `gh api repos/emyann/harness-kanban-board/issues/103/labels/kb:agent:claude -X DELETE`:

```
#103: [dry-run] would run track #107 → #108 → #111 → #106 → #109 → #110 → #103 as one claude-track session
```

**The documented setup line does not work as written.** `SKILL.md` and `references/protocol.md` both say `hkb adopt <root> --agent claude-track --status todo` is how you make a track. Following it verbatim produces a board that looks adopted, reports success, and then silently runs the slower engine. The only symptom is `tracks 0/0` in a dry-run, which nobody reads unless they already suspect something.

## What

1. **`adopt` removes every other `kb:agent:*` label** when it sets one. That is the fix.
2. **`doctor` reports a task carrying more than one `kb:agent:*` label**, since existing boards already have them.
3. Consider making the agent resolver *fail loudly* on multiple agent labels rather than silently taking the first — an ambiguous card is a bug, not a default.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb adopt <n> --agent X` leaves exactly one `kb:agent:*` label on the issue.
- [ ] A test covers adopt-over-an-existing-agent and asserts the resolved agent changed.
- [ ] `hkb doctor` flags multi-agent-label tasks with the fix.
- [ ] Re-running the worked example in `references/protocol.md` produces a claimable track with no manual label surgery.
goal: adopt leaves exactly one kb:agent:* label; doctor flags multi-label tasks; the protocol.md worked example produces a claimable track with no manual label surgery.
title: hkb adopt leaves the previous kb:agent:* label, so adopting a track silently does nothing
